summary: Round 7 desktop (1920x800) visual fixes verified end-to-end. All 5 fixes pass, zero JS errors, page scrolls cleanly from Hero to ContactUs.

verified_fixes.F1_4_lane_river: PASS — exactly 1 [data-testid=global-river] SVG on the page, 4 <text class='river-digits'> lanes present (complement pairs). bodyWidth=54, laneWidth=80 -> visibly wider river.
verified_fixes.F2_caption_trigger: PASS — captions do NOT reveal on mere viewport entry; only after logo center reaches ~45% of viewport height. After scrolling logo to ~40% vh, sequential reveal at 160ms interval visible in screenshot (Risk Scoring, Socioeconomic & Demographic Validation, Financial Inclusion, Pragati Kendra, Customer Place Verification, Rural Infra, Digital Connect all appearing).
verified_fixes.F3_larger_bolder_captions: PASS — computed font-size 17px, font-weight 800 on all decoded caption labels (9 elements matched).
verified_fixes.F4_larger_circles: PASS — hero urban orbit bounding box 340x340, rural orbit 340x340; orbit caption pills fully visible around each circle in screenshots.
verified_fixes.F5_hero_pulse_bg: PASS — [data-testid=hero-pulse-bg] present in Section 1 behind content; concentric rings, horizontal beam, center glow, and sparkles visible; headline/body text remains fully readable.
verified_fixes.regression: PASS — 0 console errors, scrolled from hero all the way to ContactUs/footer without JS errors.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: SOLUTION_CAPTIONS reveal uses two independent setInterval branches (one in LogoSolution, one via active prop cascade). Working as intended but slightly fragile; consider consolidating.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 7 fully verified on desktop 1920x800. Screenshots confirm PulseRingBackground, enlarged 340px orbits with visible caption pills, single 4-lane river, and 17px/800 decoded captions revealing sequentially only when logo passes 45% viewport.
